mission.title: Why I exist
mission.mission: To make energy a manageable variable: help companies and investors cut energy costs, protect profitability and build a credible decarbonisation path — with method, data and independence.
mission.vision: A market where energy efficiency is not a bureaucratic obligation but the most rational economic decision an organisation can take.

principles.title: Evidence
principles.description: Every recommendation rests on verifiable data, benchmarks and declared assumptions.

principles.title: Clarity
principles.description: A deliverable the management can use tomorrow is worth more than a flawless report nobody uses.

principles.title: Continuity

about.title: A senior consultant, not a salesman.
paragraphs: For more than fifteen years I have worked alongside companies and investors on energy management: from the first analysis of consumption to contract negotiation and the governance of the energy plan.

I work independently, with no commissions from suppliers or installers. My only interest is the measurable result for the client: every recommendation is backed by data, models and a clear estimate of return.
I work in complex settings — multi-site portfolios, energy-intensive industrial processes, M&A with a material energy component.
about.photoCaption: A transformer in a substation: where the energy enters the site, and where the measurement starts.

services.title: Energy consulting services
services.subtitle: Six engagements, each with a scope, a deliverable and one owner. I do not sell products: I make clear what is worth doing and what is not.

items.title: Energy audits and due diligence
items.description: Structured reviews of consumption, contracts and assets to assess risk and the room for optimisation before investing or acquiring.

items.title: Energy management and ISO 50001
items.description: Designing the energy management system: KPIs, responsibilities, monitoring and certifiable continuous improvement.

items.title: Renewables and PPAs
items.description: Technology choice, development model and contract structure for PPAs and self-consumption, to lock the price of energy over time.

items.title: Energy procurement and risk
items.description: Procurement strategy, market timing and hedging to reduce volatility and defend the budget.

items.title: Decarbonisation and ESG
items.description: A roadmap to carbon neutrality, energy accounting and reporting ready for investors and auditors.

items.title: Incentives and white certificates
items.description: Identifying, filing and reporting on national and European incentives, without slowing the other projects down.

process.title: How we work together
process.subtitle: A four-stage path, with clear deliverables and a single point of contact throughout.

steps.title: Diagnosis
steps.description: Analysis of consumption, contracts and assets in 2–3 weeks, with a clear picture of costs and risks.

steps.title: Strategy
steps.description: An action plan ranked by impact, cost and feasibility, with business case and KPIs.

steps.title: Execution
steps.description: Managing suppliers, paperwork and works, with control of costs and timelines.

steps.title: Measurement and reporting
steps.description: Verifying the savings (M&V), continuous improvement and reporting for the management.

process.outcome: The result: a business case with the KPIs, an execution plan with the suppliers and measured savings over time. One contact, from the audit to the verification.

faq.title: The answers you need
faq.subtitle: If your question is not here, write anyway: I answer personally.

items.question: How long does a consultation take?
items.answer: It depends on the scope. An initial diagnosis takes 2–3 weeks; a full efficiency project can span 6–18 months, with periodic reviews and verification of the savings.

items.question: Do you work only in Italy?
items.answer: No. I have worked in 12 countries and support clients with assets in different jurisdictions, remotely and with dedicated missions where needed.

items.question: How is the fee structured?
items.answer: Per project, per result, or a mix of the two. No hidden commission: the business case is always shared before we start.

items.question: Do you replace my energy manager?
items.answer: No. I work as senior reinforcement: I work alongside the internal team, bring method and technical skill, then transfer the capability.

items.question: Do you also handle the paperwork for incentives?
items.answer: Yes: identification, filing, reporting and liaison with the authorities, both national and European.
